description: Prominent felt. Add a new procedural woven-felt + stitched-brass-rail canvas_item shader on the bottom Tray (created in FEAT-001), and push the existing turf/rough felt grain further via the mesh .tres overrides plus a finer grain octave in turf.gdshader. Depends on FEAT-001 because the shader is assigned to the Tray node it created; otherwise self-contained. No gameplay/input touch.
steps: Read context.json and this FEAT file first. Create scripts/ui/felt_tray.gdshader with 'shader_type canvas_item;', reusing the hash2/value_noise helpers from scripts/turf.gdshader. Uniforms + defaults: felt_dark source_color ~vec4(0.133,0.227,0.149,1) (#223a26), felt_light ~vec4(0.176,0.290,0.188,1) (#2d4a30), brass ~vec4(0.722,0.573,0.247,1) (#b8923f), weave_scale hint_range(20,400)=160, weave_contrast hint_range(0,1)=0.35, fuzz_strength hint_range(0,0.3)=0.08, rail_thickness hint_range(0,0.1)=0.018, rail_inset hint_range(0,0.1)=0.010, stitch_freq hint_range(0,400)=120, tray_aspect hint_range(0.1,10)=7.0.

In felt_tray.gdshader build the basket-weave over/under mask from two orthogonal sine ridges (warp = sin(UV.x*TAU*weave_scale), weft = sin(UV.y*TAU*weave_scale)) selecting the 'on top' thread per cell via step/mod of the cell index so adjacent cells alternate; lerp albedo felt_dark<->felt_light by mask scaled by weave_contrast; add fuzz = (value_noise(UV*weave_scale*6.0)-0.5)*2.0*fuzz_strength. Tune weave_scale high enough to read clearly on the physically-small tray (bias toward MORE prominent per the brief).

In felt_tray.gdshader draw the brass rail: edge = min(min(UV.x,1.0-UV.x), min(UV.y,1.0-UV.y)); rail band is rail_inset <= edge <= rail_inset+rail_thickness in brass; within the band multiply brightness by a dashed mask step(0.5, fract(perimeter_coord*stitch_freq)) where perimeter_coord = UV.x*tray_aspect on the top/bottom bands (min(UV.y,1-UV.y) < min(UV.x,1-UV.x)) and UV.y on the left/right bands; let the four corners fill solid brass (accept small overlap, no arc-length continuity).

In scenes/ui/main_ui.tscn embed a ShaderMaterial sub-resource (shader = res://scripts/ui/felt_tray.gdshader, default param values baked in so it renders without script) and assign it to the Tray node's material property, keeping the FEAT-001 StyleBoxFlat as the fallback/base so the tray still reads dark if the shader fails to compile.

Add a minimal GDScript hook to refresh the tray_aspect shader uniform = Tray.size.x/Tray.size.y on Tray.resized (a small helper in scripts/ui/main_ui.gd or a tiny dedicated script on the Tray node). Keep it minimal; touch no gameplay/card logic.

Edit scenes/tiles/fairway-mesh.tres: shader_parameter/grain_strength 0.04 -> 0.07 and shader_parameter/stripe_strength 0.05 -> 0.06. Edit ONLY these shader_parameter/... lines; leave ArrayMesh geometry and base_color untouched.
Edit scenes/tiles/green-mesh.tres: shader_parameter/grain_strength 0.035 -> 0.06; leave stripe_strength at 0.04.
Edit scenes/tiles/deeprough-mesh.tres: shader_parameter/tuft_strength 0.09 -> 0.13; leave tuft_scale at 20.0.

In scripts/turf.gdshader add a second finer weave octave in the grain expression (mix value_noise(wxz*8.0) with value_noise(wxz*18.0)) so grain reads as woven micro-texture — this is the real shader-source change that DOES affect the pinned tiles. Keep the ROUGHNESS/METALLIC/SPECULAR matte block unchanged. For consistency only, bump the shader-file grain_strength/stripe_strength defaults toward the new values (noting this renders nothing on the pinned tiles).
In scripts/rough_turf.gdshader bump the tuft_strength/tuft_scale defaults toward the new values for consistency only (renders nothing on the pinned tiles). Do NOT repalette any base_color.
Commit locally on the branch (do NOT push): message 'feat: prominent felt - woven brass-rail tray shader + stronger turf/rough grain'.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/ui/felt_tray.gdshader exists, compiles with no errors, and is assigned as a ShaderMaterial on the Tray node's material in main_ui.tscn; if compile fails the Control falls back to the dark StyleBoxFlat and the tray still functions.

The four mesh .tres files carry exactly the new shader_parameter values (fairway grain 0.07 / stripe 0.06; green grain 0.06; rough tuft 0.11 / scale 20.0; deeprough tuft 0.13 / scale 20.0) with geometry and base_color unchanged.
turf.gdshader and rough_turf.gdshader compile with no errors.
Running the live-hand wiring test exits 0 (16/16) and the turn-loop test exits 0 (40/40).
A headless '--editor --quit' (or GOLF.tscn load) produces no new errors beyond the FEAT-001 baseline.

findings: COMPLETED. All three gates clean, matching FEAT-001 baseline: editor '--editor --quit' -> ZERO ERROR/SHADER ERROR/SCRIPT ERROR lines (only the known fly_camera_addon project.godot WARNING on the editor path); test_live_hand_wiring 16/16 exit 0; test_turn_loop 40/40 exit 0; GOLF.tscn 90-frame headless load clean (felt shader compiled on the rendering backend with no error). PITFALL CAUGHT: Godot 4 shaders already define TAU as a built-in const -- declaring 'const float TAU = ...' in felt_tray.gdshader caused 'SHADER ERROR: Redefinition of TAU' on first compile. Fixed by removing the declaration and using the built-in TAU directly. Any future shader added to this project should NOT redefine TAU/PI/E. SHADER: scripts/ui/felt_tray.gdshader is 'shader_type canvas_item', reuses turf's hash2/value_noise, builds a basket-weave over/under mask (two orthogonal sine ridges warp=sin(UV.x*TAU*weave_scale)/weft=sin(UV.y*TAU*weave_scale), alternating top thread via mod(cell_x+cell_y,2)), lerps felt_dark<->felt_light by mask*weave_contrast, adds value_noise fuzz, and draws a dashed brass rail (edge=min of the four UV edge distances; band rail_inset..rail_inset+rail_thickness; dash via step(0.5,fract(perimeter_coord*stitch_freq)) with perimeter_coord = UV.x*tray_aspect on top/bottom bands else UV.y; corners solid brass). Defaults baked so it renders script-free. ASSIGNMENT: main_ui.tscn load_steps 18->20, added ext_resource id=17_felt + sub_resource ShaderMaterial_felt (all defaults baked), assigned to %Tray.material; the FEAT-001 StyleBoxFlat_tray panel stays as the base/fallback so the tray still reads dark if the shader fails. SCRIPT HOOK: main_ui.gd adds @onready tray=%Tray and in _ready() connects tray.resized -> _on_tray_resized() which sets the 'tray_aspect' shader_parameter = tray.size.x/tray.size.y (guards non-ShaderMaterial and size.y<=0); called once at _ready too. No gameplay/card logic touched. TURF: scripts/turf.gdshader grain now mix(value_noise(wxz*8.0), value_noise(wxz*18.0), 0.5)-0.5 (finer woven micro-octave; matte ROUGHNESS/METALLIC/SPECULAR block unchanged); file defaults bumped grain_strength 0.04->0.07, stripe_strength 0.05->0.06 (consistency only; pinned .tres values are what render). rough_turf.gdshader defaults bumped tuft_scale 16->20, tuft_strength 0.08->0.11 (consistency only). MESH .tres (pinned values that actually render): fairway grain 0.07/stripe 0.06; green grain 0.06 (stripe left 0.04); rough tuft 0.11/scale 20.0; deeprough tuft 0.13/scale 20.0. Geometry/base_color untouched on all four.
